descriptionChirho: Substantive use referring to persons: no one, nobody, not anyone — used as a pronoun denying the existence or involvement of any person.
Substantive use referring to things: nothing, not anything — used as a pronoun denying the existence or relevance of any thing or matter.
Adjectival use modifying a noun directly: no, not any — functioning as a determiner that negates the noun it qualifies.
